metadata.scenario: A patient requires immediate advice from a doctor about a severe allergic reaction. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I need immediate help! Hi Betty, I’m here to help. What’s going on? I’m having a severe allergic reaction. My face is swelling, and I can’t breathe properly! Oh no, that sounds serious. Have you called 911 or gone to the nearest hospital? No, I thought I could call you first. What should I do? It’s crucial you call 911 immediately, Betty. Your safety is the priority. Okay, I’ll do that. But what else can I do? If you have an EpiPen or any allergy medication, use it as instructed. I do have an EpiPen. Should I use it now? Yes, as soon as possible, then call for help. I’m really scared, Margaret. I understand, Betty. Just focus on breathing slowly. Help will be on the way soon. Thank you. I’ll call 911 now. Once you’re safe, please call us back. We can coordinate any necessary follow-up care. Will do, but what if I need more help later? We can arrange for in-home care for monitoring post-reaction, like skilled nursing if needed. That sounds good. How much is that service? Skilled nursing care is between $95 and $125 per visit. Okay, thank you for the information. Of course. Just make sure to prioritize your health right now. I appreciate your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Betty. Stay safe, and call us once you’re settled. I will. Thanks again! Take care, Betty. Goodbye!
